description: The chart illustrates the popularity of different models across two categories, "Songs" and "Basketball". The horizontal axis contains the categories, with "Songs" on the left and "Basketball" on the right, while the vertical axis represents "Popularity" with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 220, marked at intervals of 40. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a category and containing three sets of bars corresponding to the models "Llma3", "Qwen2", and "ChatGPT", colored blue, red, and yellow, respectively. Within each set, there are three bars distinguished by different patterns: dots for "Acc=0 & GT Ans", diagonal lines for "Acc=0 & Gene Ans", and no pattern for "Acc=1 & GT Ans". For "Songs", the popularity values range from approximately 60 to 70, with "Qwen2" having the highest value around 70 for "Acc=0 & GT Ans". For "Basketball", the values are significantly higher, ranging from around 140 to over 220, with "Qwen2" reaching the highest value of approximately 230 for "Acc=0 & Gene Ans". The bars are not sorted in a specific order within the categories, and there is no visual emphasis on particular bars.
